claims.claim: UnifiedStateObservation exposes a deterministic bounded collection of exact outstanding-finding identities without removing or reinterpreting existing selectors.
Multi-finding PRIMARY CHANGES_REQUIRED reduces to CORRECTION/AUTHOR_REMEDIATION with full outstanding identities and no implicitly selected finding_id.
DELTA PASS with remaining siblings reduces to correction-authoring state with those siblings exposed, while an empty frontier continues toward publication/DONE.
Existing single-finding AUTHOR_REMEDIATION and EXECUTE_REMEDIATION behavior remains compatible and still uses exact canonical preflight selectors.
HumanSurfaceResult exposes the same bounded outstanding identities and does not delegate a multi-finding correction merely because an Executor was supplied.
Tests prove observation order does not create priority, malformed/inconsistent frontier lineage fails closed, and no Unified State/Human Surface mutation authority expands.
No P3A/P3B, publication, REVIEW/REMEDIATION, REMEDIATION execution-base, REPAIR, retry, reroute, or historical-artifact semantics change.
